competition_search_terms: AI generated content disclosure register publisher review signoff software
EU AI Act Article 50 editorial disclosure compliance workflow
AI content provenance declaration register publishing audit
yapay zeka içerik şeffaflığı açıklama editör onayı kayıt yazılımı
results.market_gap: Potential article-level editorial responsibility, AI-use lineage and public-interest disclosure decision evidence; exact publisher-facing specialized competitors not established in searches.
results.mvp: Publisher content item ledger, AI model usage and edits declaration, public-interest flag, documented substantive human review, editorial-responsibility signoff, disclosure export.
results.working_logic: Open publication case -> record AI assistance and substantive edits -> determine applicability -> editor reviews and assumes responsibility -> publish with disclosure where applicable -> export decision record.
results.build_time: not_verified; 95 credits implies >=4 free-tier months theoretical at 30 credits/month
results.marketing_strategy: Consult EU public-interest editors and legal teams; do not market as blanket mandatory disclosures for every AI-assisted text.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with a single publisher to document genuine editorial review and article-50 disclosures without integrating restricted model-provenance detectors.
results.main_risk: Misinterpreting AI Act Article 50(4) human-editorial-control exception; audit records alone are not legal compliance; competition insufficiently checked.
results.validation_assumption: Publishers need a standalone Article 50 decision register rather than existing CMS and policies.
results.local_applicability_rationale: EU regulatory obligation, market EU-focused; Türkiye scope not asserted.
results.review_notes: EU AI Act Article 50(4) requires disclosure of AI-generated public-interest text unless substantive human review/editorial control plus editorial responsibility applies. Do not falsely assert every AI-assisted text must be labelled. Restricted provenance detector not used. Direct competitor count means 0 verified in limited research, not proven absence of global products.

global_competitors.reason: Direct: explicitly serves fleet operators 50+ vehicles with battery pack service/repair records, warranty approvals, serial-linked diagnostics, part replacements, and complete pack history; same buyer, job and workflow.

global_competitors.name: Oxmaint EV Fleet Maintenance
global_competitors.reason: Direct: fleet asset manager workflow combines battery SoH records, defects, service history, warranty decisions and replacement evidence within EV fleet maintenance operations.

adjacent_competitors.name: AVILOO Türkiye Premium Test
adjacent_competitors.reason: Same used-car buyer, but battery SoH/range testing and certificate rather than integrated repair events and warranty decisions.

adjacent_competitors.name: AVILOO Certified
adjacent_competitors.reason: Used-EV dealer SoH verification and resale certificate; repair timeline not evidenced.

adjacent_competitors.name: BattGrade
adjacent_competitors.reason: Same used-EV dealer/fleet buyers, but early-access battery-health certificates; repair/warranty case management not evidenced.

adjacent_competitors.name: Battery Passport Software
adjacent_competitors.reason: Repair and warranty history workflow overlaps, but its primary buyers work on e-bikes and other light electric vehicle batteries, not used passenger-EV dealers and car fleets.

adjacent_competitors.name: Sibros
adjacent_competitors.reason: OEM battery-passport workflows with different primary buyer.

adjacent_competitors.name: TWAICE Fleet Operator Analytics
adjacent_competitors.reason: Same fleet buyer for SoH and warranty management but explicit repair event passport not established.

competition_search_terms: ikinci el araç batarya sağlık raporu tamir geçmişi
EV lifecycle passport dealer repair history
results.market_gap: Generic passenger EV fleet battery health, repair-service and warranty passport is served by EvNova BSMS and Oxmaint. A narrower niche would require separate proof.
results.mvp: Battery report upload, pack identifier, repair events, warranty checklist, export.
results.working_logic: Import technician report -> attach repairs -> assess warranty policy -> export.
results.first_customer_plan: Interview used-EV dealers about unsolved repair-history workflows.
results.main_risk: Adjacent workshop product can expand into cars; specialized SoH vendors could add repair history; no willingness-to-pay proof.
results.validation_assumption: Passenger EV dealer/fleet buyers need a repair-event and warranty decision desk distinct from existing SoH certificates; not proven.
results.competition_confidence: high: current vendor primary pages verify same fleet buyer and materially same battery lifecycle+repair+warranty workflow.
results.review_notes: EU passport applies to specified batteries entering EU market from February 2027; does not imply all pre-existing used EVs require retroactive certificates. Previously counted direct SoH providers reclassified as adjacent since they do not demonstrate the full repair-event/warranty-decision workflow. Follow-up on 2026-10-08: a buyer-specific EV fleet repair/warranty platform was verified, resolving earlier mistaken assumption that only adjacent health certificates existed.

source_verification.method: Full publisher article content and date checked
source_verification.author: 邢书博
source_verification.finding: October 7 Huxiu auto-industry analysis discusses EV battery 15,000-cycle energy-storage target, vehicle-specific endurance standards, repair economics and battery asset records. The 15,000-cycle claim is not a passenger-car 20-year durability requirement.
source_verification.important_limit: Cited Chinese policy/standards and statistics are the article's claims; policy primary sources were NOT separately verified.

competitor_recheck.rule: same buyer + same core job + substantially same workflow
competitor_recheck.notes: Both competitors serve fleet battery records and warranty decisions; no zero-cash proof needed for a rejected candidate.

results.rejection_reason: EvNova BSMS explicitly sells battery serial-level repair, warranty approval and service history to electric fleet operators; Oxmaint EV fleet maintenance covers health/service/warranty records for same fleet manager buyer. Core proposed workflow is already available; no differentiated unmet need evidenced.
